name: ETAA1 activator of ATR kinase
pathways: positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: ETAA1 encodes ewing's tumor-associated antigen 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA damage response.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
